verdict: AVGO guidance miss triggered semi selloff & HBM3e prices declining (early correction signal); offset by $725B hyperscaler capex above baseline and MRVL +30% on Jensen Huang endorsement — mixed/cautious tone with structural bull intact.
body_md:
## Fresh Developments (Last 24-72h)

**Signal 1 — DRAM/HBM Pricing:** TrendForce confirms Q2-2026 conventional DRAM +58-63% QoQ and NAND +70-75% QoQ — a deceleration from Q1's ~90-95% DRAM spike. Key bear nuance: HBM3e contract prices are now **declining** as buyers hold healthy inventory and three-way supplier competition intensifies. This is early confirmation of the baseline correction-risk signal.

**Signal 2 — HBM4 Ramp:** SK Hynix slowed HBM4 ramp (pushed to Q3-2026), citing continued HBM3e demand occupying existing lines. All three suppliers on track for HBM4 12-layer ramp with 16-layer push per NVIDIA demand. HBM3e price decline is the live canary for the post-2026 correction thesis.

**Signal 3 — Hyperscaler AI Capex:** No guide-down. Combined GOOGL/AMZN/MSFT/META 2026 capex now tracking ~$725B (+77% YoY) — above the $600-700B baseline range. Meta raised guide to $125-145B. Strongest bull signal in the complex.

**Signal 4 — AMD MI400/Helios + Custom ASIC:** AMD MI400/Helios confirmed on track for 2H-2026 (Feb 2026 update). Marvell projects $11B AI ASIC 2026 revenue; AVGO + MRVL now control ~95% of custom AI ASIC co-design per May 2026 Tom's Hardware state-of-play. No incremental June 13 AMD news.

**Signal 5 — Optical/Photonics:** COHR demonstrated full CPO multi-tech portfolio at OFC 2026 (SiPh + InP + VCSEL, roadmap to 12.8T+). InP supply gap remains ~70%. CPO mass deployment horizon still 2028-2030. No fresh June 13 catalyst.

**Signal 6 — Solar:** Section 232 polysilicon tariff decision now expected mid-to-late June per UBS — decision window is **this week or next**. FSLR hit 18-year intraday high of $310.42 on tariff speculation before pulling back to ~$259 (down ~21% from peak, still +48% YTD). UBS raised PT to $330 (Buy). US module prices stable at ~$0.28/W; potential Section 232 could add $0.20/W tariff on finished modules.

**Signal 7 — Watchlist:** See movers below.

---

## Watchlist Movers

| Name | Move | Catalyst |
|------|------|----------|
| MRVL | **+30%+** (~$290) | Jensen Huang (NVIDIA CEO) publicly named Marvell as a potential "next trillion-dollar company" — biggest hyperscaler AI ASIC endorsement of the cycle |
| AVGO | **-15%** (June 4-5) | Q3 AI chip guide $16B vs $17.2B consensus; FY2027 outlook held at $100B; erased ~$350B market cap, dragged sector |
| MU | -11.5% (AVGO fallout) | Caught in broad semi selloff; **earnings June 24** is next binary catalyst |
| NVDA | -7% (AVGO fallout) | Sector contagion; no NVDA-specific negative |
| FSLR | +48% YTD, hit $310 then ~$259 | Section 232 tariff speculation + UBS PT raise to $330 |
| HIVE | Bullish targets June 11 | FY2026 revenue +158% to $297.8M; HPC ARR $35M; $30M B200 GPU cloud contract; Toronto 320 MW AI gigafactory planned |
| AMD | +130% YTD, Q1 rev $10.3B | Data center +57% YoY; MI400/Helios 2H-2026 is next catalyst |

*No notable moves on: ALAB, CRDO, COHR, LITE, CIEN, ENPH, NXT, ARRY, NOW, ZS, CRM, SNOW, TSLA, GDDY, NOK, AMPX, ALMU, RMBS, MRAM, WDC, STX, SanDisk (SNDK) in last 24-72h.*

---

## Context vs Baseline

- Conventional DRAM memflation still running hot but **decelerating** (Q1: ~90-95% → Q2: ~58-63%). Still well above historical norms.
- **HBM3e prices declining now** — the baseline's "correction after 2026" may be front-running into mid-2026 at the HBM3e tier. Watch whether this bleeds into HBM4 pricing as SK Hynix/Samsung/Micron all ramp simultaneously late 2026.
- Hyperscaler capex ($725B) is running **above** the baseline ceiling ($700B) — strongest structural bull signal in the complex.
- AVGO's guidance miss is the first concrete data point that AI infrastructure demand may not be infinitely elastic. Market is now hypersensitive to any softness in AI chip guides.
- MRVL at $250B market cap post-Jensen endorsement — custom ASIC thesis accelerating per plan.

---

## Signals Flashing

| Signal | Direction | Bull/Bear |
|--------|-----------|-----------|
| Conventional DRAM pricing Q2 | +58-63% QoQ | Bull (decelerating) |
| HBM3e contract prices | Declining | **Bear** — correction risk live |
| Hyperscaler AI capex | $725B, above baseline | **Bull** |
| Custom ASIC share (MRVL/AVGO) | Accelerating | Bull for MRVL/AVGO |
| Optical/InP supply gap | ~70%, persisting | Bull for COHR/LITE |
| Solar/Section 232 decision | Imminent (end of June) | Potential Bull for FSLR |
| Semi sector sentiment | AVGO-triggered volatility | Mixed/cautious |

---

## Most Important Development

**MRVL +30%+ on Jensen Huang "next trillion-dollar company" comment** is the single highest-impact watchlist event: it's a named hyperscaler endorsement of custom silicon that aligns perfectly with the baseline ASIC share-shift thesis. Close second: **HBM3e prices declining** in real-time — the post-2026 correction call in the baseline may be arriving at the HBM3e tier several months early, setting up a meaningful medium-term bear signal for memory names (MU, WDC) heading into late 2026. MU earnings on June 24 is the next hard catalyst.
